description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the TimesheetDao component within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes setup routines, test cases for CRUD operations on timesheets, timesheet items, action logs, and report generation functions, utilizing fixture data for testing various scenarios.

classes.name: TimesheetDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating the functionality of the TimesheetDao class, including CRUD operations, report queries, and duplication checks related to timesheets and timesheet items.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of TimesheetDao and populating fixture data.

methods.name: testAddTimesheet
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new timesheet, asserting the saved object matches expected data.

methods.name: testDuplicateTimesheet
methods.description: Checks whether duplicate timesheets exist for given employees and start dates.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetActionLogs
methods.description: Retrieves and validates timesheet action logs for a specific timesheet.

methods.name: testAddTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Creates and saves a new timesheet action log, verifying its properties.

methods.name: testGetMyTimesheets
methods.description: Fetches timesheets filtered by employee number and date range.

methods.name: testIsDuplicateTimesheetItem
methods.description: Checks whether a timesheet item is a duplicate based on project, activity, and timesheet IDs.

methods.name: testAddTimesheetItem
methods.description: Creates and saves a new timesheet item, verifying its properties.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific timesheet item by timesheet ID and item ID.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetById
methods.description: Retrieves a timesheet by its ID, verifying its data.

methods.name: testSaveAndUpdateTimesheetItemsExceptionCase
methods.description: Verifies that saving timesheet items with inconsistent project activity and project IDs throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTimesheetList
methods.description: Fetches a list of employee timesheets based on various filters and asserts expected results.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTimesheetListCount
methods.description: Checks the count of employee timesheets matching certain filters.

methods.name: testGetLatestTimesheet
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the latest timesheet for an employee with and without date filters.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReportAndTotalHours
methods.description: Verifies report data and total hours calculations for various filter configurations.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemsCountForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Verifies the count of timesheet items matching report filters.

methods.name: testTimesheetAvailability
methods.description: Checks the availability or existence of a specific timesheet item for a given project, timesheet, activity, and date.
